story.title: Civilian plane crash in New Mexico tied to military GPS blocking

draft:
A civilian plane crash in New Mexico has raised questions about military GPS blocking. 
I've been following this story and it's clear that the use of GPS blocking technology by the military can have unintended consequences. 
The crash highlights the need for better coordination between military and civilian aviation systems. 
What safeguards can be put in place to prevent such incidents in the future?
#GPSblocking #AviationTech #MilitaryTech
